root_cause.description: The proxy reward and simulator branch computed safety clearance as Euclidean center distance minus longitudinal vehicle half-lengths. Vehicles in adjacent 3.5 m lanes were therefore assigned negative bumper gaps even when their oriented boxes did not overlap.
root_cause.contract_mismatch: The production PlatoonNormalPlanner defines the frozen 5 m background and 7 m platoon gaps as longitudinal bumper clearance only while vehicles occupy the same lateral corridor.
root_cause.effect: All development candidates were classified unsafe before tracking aggregation, so no tracking envelope could be derived and holdout calibration correctly stopped.

changes: Use minimum_dense_background_gap for proxy background clearance.
Use minimum_dense_pair_gap for proxy platoon clearance.
Use minimum_dense_pair_gap for instantaneous simulator background and platoon clearance.
Retain oriented-box collision, out-of-road, 5 m background and 7 m platoon hard gates.
